responsibility: Implements gm2’s core quadruple intermediate representation and its associated boolean/operand stacks. It allocates and stores quad records, manages operator-specific metadata such as token numbers, annotations, overflow-check flags, and read/write relationships, emits the IR for modules, procedures, statements, expressions, constructors, exception handling, and inline asm, and maintains the numerous control stacks and patch lists that parser passes use to build structured flow before optimization and lowering to GCC trees.
same_name_distinction: This `.mod` file is the concrete quad engine, with the data structures, stack management, quad allocation, and builder logic behind the IR; the same-name `.def` file serves instead as the broad interface declaration consumed by parser and later passes.
